description: This Java class 'DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig' provides a configuration implementation for persistence streams, including settings for bulk size, parallelism, and exponential back-off. It is part of a larger service framework related to 'thingsearch' within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for persistence stream settings, including max bulk size, parallelism, and exponential back-off configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig from a given Typesafe Config object.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of bulk operations.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Retrieves the parallelism setting from the default stream stage configuration.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Provides the exponential back-off configuration for retries or back pressure.
